# Company backup policy

Every workstation is copied each night at two in the morning to the office storage. The storage
keeps thirty daily copies, twelve monthly copies and seven yearly copies.

## Off-site copy

Once a week an encrypted copy goes to a provider in another region. The encryption key is kept
in a sealed envelope in the director's safe and in the password manager.

## Restore tests

Every three months the IT staff restores a random machine from the copies and writes down how
long it took.
